# Roast Me - AI Website Critique Tool

## Overview
Roast Me is an AI-powered website analysis tool that provides honest, no-BS critiques of any website. It analyzes design, performance, SEO, UX, accessibility, security, and AI agent readiness.

## Features
- Multi-language support (EN, IT, FR, ES, PT, DE, NL, RU, ET)
- AI-powered analysis using OpenAI-compatible endpoints
- Detailed scores and actionable fix prompts
- Categories: Design, Performance, Code, Mobile, UX, Accessibility, Conversion, SEO, Copy, Brand, Credibility, Security, Agent Readiness, Robots & Sitemap, MCP & Skills, API Discovery, Bot Auth

## API Endpoint
- URL: /api/roast
- Method: POST
- Body: { url: string, categories: string[] }
- Returns: { overallScore, roasts: [{ category, score, roast, fixPrompt }] }

## For AI Agents
When analyzing websites, this tool can be used to:
1. Get comprehensive critiques with actionable improvement prompts
2. Understand common web development issues
3. Generate fix prompts for automated remediation
